newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END HIGHER IN TIGHT MONEY SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END HIGHER IN TIGHT MONEY SUPPLY.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished at 23.50 percent on Thursday, up from Wednesday's close of 23.125 percent, traders said.
"With the end of the banks' two-week reserve period on Sunday, Friday will be the last chance to top off reserves, so banks prefer to err on the side of caution," said Eva Patzauer of Creditanstalt.

Despite a general downward trend towards the end of the two-week reserve period, repo rate cut expectations meant that most available funds are tied up in the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility.
The ensuing tight liquidity kept overnight rates around 23.125 percent for the first half this week.
With most banks having already filled their reserves, slightly higher liquidity on Friday could push overnight rates down, traders said.
